'''Talvani''' is the [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Capital capital] of [[Quidic]], the [[1756 FLLA World Cup|1756 FLLA World Cup]] champions and the twentieth-largest national economy by nominal [[List of countries by GDP (nominal)|GDP]] in the world. The city is home to the '''Talvani Museum of Sport''', which holds in perpetuity '''The Eserni''', the permanent trophy of the [[1756 FLLA World Cup]] commissioned by the joint [[QUFVL]] hosting consortium of [[Erkizil]], [[Quidic]], [[Wundry]] and [[Ztesh]].
